title: Insurance Claim Services Policy on Releasing Recoverable Depreciation
content:
**Policy.** The claim file must be in approved status when a depreciation release is requested. Recoverable depreciation withheld on a replacement cost claim is released by the carrier only once the work is shown complete. The job named in the request must be complete: a water, fire or mold job in drying complete, cleaning complete, cleared, invoiced or closed status, a rebuild contract in substantially complete, final invoiced or closed status, or a contents job in returned, invoiced or closed status. A depreciation release may be requested only no later than the depreciation window after the first ACV payment was received on the claim file. The depreciation window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the received date of the earliest ACV carrier payment on the file, and a request submitted on the last day of the window is in time. The amount requested is the depreciation withheld on the approvals of that coverage part less any depreciation already released on it. Once the window has passed without a request, the withheld depreciation is written off as depreciation forfeited and becomes the customer's own responsibility on tiers where denied amounts are billable to the customer.

This Insurance Claim Services policy governs every depreciation release request. The window length, whether completion is required and whether the company requests the release itself are each tier's own figures.

## Retired clause

- "The amount requested is the depreciation withheld on the approvals of that coverage part less any depreciation already released on it." is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current Insurance Claim Services basis. Every other sentence of the policy remains in force.

## Completion by kind of job

| Job named in the request | Complete when its status is |
|---|---|
| water, fire or mold job | drying complete, cleaning complete, cleared, invoiced or closed |
| rebuild contract | substantially complete, final invoiced or closed |
| contents job | returned, invoiced or closed |

The status is read from the system record of the job named in the request; the file's own status on the system record must be approved.

## The window

- Clock: the received date of the earliest ACV carrier payment on the claim file (the system record).
- Day 1 is the day after that date; the last day of the window is that date plus the tier's window days; a request on the last day is in time, a request the day after is late.
- *Hypothetical, 180-day window:* earliest ACV payment received on day D. A request on day D plus 180 is in time; on day D plus 181 it is not.
- After the window has passed with no request, the withheld depreciation is written off as depreciation forfeited, and it becomes the customer's own responsibility on tiers where denied amounts are billable to the customer.

superseded_clauses: The amount requested is the depreciation withheld on the approvals of that coverage part less any depreciation already released on it.
